## Lake-periods through time

The values that enter the models, one per lake-period, placed in time. Before the remodelling these
figures showed the steps between consecutive sampled centuries, which are mostly sampling noise.

```{r}
show_figure('report/figures/supplementary/fig_tracking_transition_rates.pdf')
show_figure('report/figures/supplementary/fig_tracking_transition_ratios_angles.pdf')
```

**Lake-period values over time.** One column per lake. Each lake-period is a bar from its oldest
to its youngest sampled century at its value, with its symbol at the middle (circles climate-change
periods, triangles stability periods), under the C (darker) and S (lighter) period bands. The last
column holds the Anthropocene plot pairs of each park as boxplots, on their own scale, because their
values are much larger. First figure: climate change rate (calibration SD per century), turnover,
lag rate, pace and direction effects (CCA distance per century) and fire activity (events per century
per core). Second figure: the magnitude tracking ratio (unitless, 1 = observed and predicted moved
equally far), the movement angle (degrees, 90 = perpendicular to the predicted direction), the climate
change rate and fire activity. Ratios and angles are left out where a position did not move.
